[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
import Lean.Data.String

def implementation (string: String) (substring: String) : Nat :=
let n := string.length
let m := substring.length
if m = 0 then
  n
else
  let rec count_from (i: Nat) (occurrences: Nat) : Nat :=
    if i + m > n then
      occurrences
    else
      let sub := string.substr i m
      if sub = substring then
        count_from (i + 1) (occurrences + 1)
      else
        count_from (i + 1) occurrences
  count_from 0 0
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma string_substr_length
(s: String)
(i: Nat)
(m: Nat)
: (i + m ≤ s.length → s.substr i m.length = s.substr i m) ∧
(i + m > s.length → s.substr i m.length = "")
:=
by
  unfold String.substr
  split
  intro h
  cases h
  simp
  apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right
  linarith
  simp
  linarith

lemma string_substr_eq
(s: String)
(i: Nat)
(m: Nat)
(s': String)
(s'' : String)
: (s.substr i m = s' → s.substr i m = s'') ∧
(s.substr i m = s' → s' = s.substr i m) ∧
(s.substr i m = s' → s'' = s'.substr i m)
:=
by
  unfold String.substr
  simp
  split
  intro h
  simp [h]
  simp [h]
  simp [h]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation string substring
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
split
-- case when substring.length = 0
intro h_substring_len_0
have h_string_len := string_substr_length string 0 0 h_substring_len_0
have h_substring_eq := h_string_len.left
have h_substring_eq': string.substr 0 0 = "" := by
  simp [h_substring_eq]
have h_result_eq_string_len := by
  simp [h_string_len.right, h_substring_eq']
simp [h_result_eq_string_len]
-- case when substring.length ≠ 0
have h_substring_len_ne_0 := by
  linarith
split
-- case when string.length < substring.length
intro h_string_len_lt_substring_len
have h_result_eq_0 := by
  simp [h_result_eq_string_len, h_string_len_lt_substring_len]
simp [h_result_eq_0]
-- case when string.length = substring.length
have h_string_len_eq_substring_len := by
  simp [h_string_len_ne_0]
split
-- case when string = substring
intro h_string_eq_substring
have h_result_eq_1 := by
  simp [h_result_eq_string_len, h_string_len_eq_substring_len, h_string_eq_substring]
simp [h_result_eq_1]
-- case when string ≠ substring
intro h_string_ne_substring
have h_result_eq_0 := by
  simp [h_result_eq_string_len, h_string_len_eq_substring_len, h_string_ne_substring]
simp [h_result_eq_0]
-- case when string.length < substring.length
intro h_string_len_lt_substring_len
have h_result_eq_0 := by
  simp [h_result_eq_string_len, h_string_len_lt_substring_len]
simp [h_result_eq_0]
-- case when substring.length < string.length
have h_substring_len_lt_string_len := by
  linarith
split
-- case when substring_start_idx is empty
intro h_substring_start_idx_empty
have h_result_eq_0 := by
  simp [h_result_eq_string_len, h_string_len_eq_substring_len, h_substring_start_idx_empty]
simp [h_result_eq_0]
-- case when substring_start_idx is non-empty
intro h_substring_start_idx_non_empty
have h_substring_occurrences := h_substring_start_idx_non_empty
have h_result_eq_occurrences := by
  simp [h_result_eq_string_len, h_string_len_eq_substring_len, h_substring_occurrences]
simp [h_result_eq_occurrences]
[END]
